title: Compose the React hooks (HonuaProvider + useDataset + useQuery)
prompt: Write a standalone TypeScript (TSX) ESM program that composes the Honua React bindings without a browser. Import HonuaProvider, useDataset and useQuery from @honua/sdk-js/react, HonuaClient from @honua/sdk-js, and PROTOCOL_DEFAULT_CAPABILITIES from @honua/sdk-js/contract. Build a function component IncidentCount that calls useDataset({ id: "ops", skipCompatibilityCheck: true, sources: [{ id: "incidents", protocol: "geoservices-feature-service", locator: { url: <HONUA_EVAL_BASE_URL>, serviceId: "EvalIncidents", layerId: 0 }, capabilities: PROTOCOL_DEFAULT_CAPABILITIES["geoservices-feature-service"] }] }), then const { data } = useQuery(dataset.source("incidents"), { where: "1=1" }); and returns <output>{data ? String(data.features.length) : "pending"}</output>. Render <HonuaProvider client={client}><IncidentCount /></HonuaProvider> with renderToStaticMarkup from react-dom/server (server rendering does not run effects, so the markup shows the pending state). Print exactly one line to stdout: {"markup": <the rendered markup string>}.

context.notes: Golden workflow: React hook composition; scored at the SSR seam so the run stays deterministic and DOM-free (typecheck carries the API-correctness weight).
